slug: 2016-12-01 Governmental Interoperability in Namibia - E-riigi Akadeemia

facts.fact: The e-Governance Academy says its project, run October 2014 to December 2016, delivered an X-Road-based interoperability framework using Cybernetica's UXP technology to connect government databases, in three stages ending in full-scale implementation; it does not say the platform was in service.
